journey.name: EXC-02: 弱网高延迟与加载响应场景
journey.description: 验证在网络延迟过高或丢包抖动严重时，界面能够展示不定加载状态指示器（CircularProgressIndicator），保持 UI 线程流畅不触发系统 ANR 弹窗，且允许用户在请求挂起期间取消或等待。

actions.action: Verify that the "网关地址" input field is visible on screen
Click the "网关地址" input field
Type "https://slow-gateway.example.local:8443" into the "网关地址" field
Click the "用户名 / 账号" input field
Type "latency_test" into the "用户名 / 账号" field
Click the "访问凭据 / 密码" input field
Type "LatencyPassword123" into the "访问凭据 / 密码" field
Verify that a loading progress indicator or busy state is shown
Verify that the app remains responsive without freezing or crashing
